title: Chapter 7154: Eternal Lamp

Chapter 7154: Eternal Lamp

Chapter 7154: Eternal Lamp

“Yes, enough for your group, you have lived long enough.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Come take our heads then, Sir.” Gluttonous said.

“Do you think there is an actual chance of survival?” Li Qiye asked.

“Sir, you might be unfathomable but our foundation is extraordinary. You will pay a heavy price by forcing us to go all out. Can you afford to be injured before the calamity?” Kun Peng took a deep breath and said.

“Frogs under the well, there’s no price for killing you all. I’m only letting you talk out of mercy.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Let’s try it then.” Death Serpent was eager to try.

“Ooo-” He roared and exerted his gift to the limit, becoming gigantic. Countless serpents split from his body, slithering across the rivers of time.

One serpent with a majestic aura came from an ancient era. Another wielded the power of sinflames. The third had a void body...

Endless Form was the serpent’s innate gift. Death Serpent, a grand completion divine beast, could use this ability to the highest level.

“That’s it?” Li Qiye waved his hands at the countless serpents and somehow smashed all of them.

Despite their size and number, they appeared as feeble as spiderwebs. Thus, he sliced and tore through them, causing blood to gush like oceans.

This forced Death Serpent to assume its original form, bellowing in pain.

“You dare?!” Lunar Wolf roared at Li Qiye, utilizing its Omni Howl.

The howl illuminated the whole battlefield, taking the form of a radiant pulse. All lost overlords and immortals could see it clearly.

“Boom!” It struck Li Qiye with a force capable of piercing a primordial immortal such as Apex. Alas, it only left a wisp of smoke on Li Qiye’s chest.

“Okay.” Li Qiye smiled.

Lunar Wolf was shocked since he had used all of his power. That should have been enough to injure a celestial immortal.

“Bam!” Li Qiye casually swiped and dispelled the pulse, treating it like candlelight.

Next, he punched the wolf’s jaw, breaking many bones.

“Ahh!” The wolf screamed with a pulverized mouth.

Qilin roared, conjuring a flame. Within was a lamp capable of shining and burning worlds - Eternal Lamp.

“No!!!” Immortals, who came searching for a way out, were reduced to ashes by the lamp’s radiating heatwaves.

The lamp then focused all types of flames, such as sin, life, and many others, on Li Qiye.
